correctness.rationale: The theorem is explicitly restricted to Q4 and A=F_2(Q4) versus B=F_infinity(Q4). From the actual 10-blob package, independently enumerated all 2^16 induced subgraphs using the exact cycle/degree predicates, obtaining A face vector (16,120,560,1732,3552,4616,3392,922) and B (16,120,560,1796,4080,6488,6848,4090,1008,8). A separately implemented sparse SIGNED integer unit-pivot elimination returned ranks (15,105,455,1277,2275,2341,922) with zero residual in every boundary, certifying unit Smith factors and integral Htilde_6(A)=Z^129 and no other reduced integral homology; independent GF2 ranks for B were (15,105,455,1341,2739,3749,3090,1000,8). Mod-two inclusion on independently constructed actual cycles modulo B boundaries has rank 9; Euler characteristic + mod-two bound forces rational B rank9, and absence of 2-primary torsion in the target degree, together with free H6(A), makes the rational map surjective, kernel120. Full 2-skeleton implies simply-connected, and homological Whitehead plus Hurewicz yields wedge^129 S6; no inference about integral B or higher-dimensional hypercubes. Source verify.py reconstructs boundaries and integration; independently implemented checkers were executed, not just its logs.

value.rationale: The intermediate degree-two induced-forest filtration on the canonical 16-vertex hypercube is a natural transition from independence constraints toward unrestricted induced forests; it is not an arbitrary graph parameter slice. The integral wedge^129 S6 and nine surviving sixth-homology classes furnish an exact nontrivial persistence benchmark, distinguishing degree constraints from connectivity and mere maximum induced forest order. The exact finite invariant is independently useful for developing graph-forest filtration methods even without a full Q_n classification.
residual_risks: No higher-dimensional uniform pattern or complete barcode is demonstrated, and no such downstream theorem is required for value.

limitations: Only Q4, degree-two stage and terminal rational persistence; no integral terminal-type, odd-primary torsion or arbitrary-Q_n assertion.
